title: inventory_items
description: Every fuel card, transponder, ELD, key, PPE item, device or document the carrier owns, with where it may go (handling), where it is (unit and / or driver) and its alert. The List tab, item page, holder pages, Manage inventory and the Monitoring feed all read this collection.

carrierId.description: → `carriers._id` (Account). Every query starts with it. (The prototype has no carrier field on the item; it is implied by the seed bucket.)

vendorId.description: → `vendors._id`; must belong to the same carrier.

categoryId.description: → `inventory_categories._id`. Empty = falls back to the vendor's category.

handling.description: Where the item MAY go. At least one value.

serial.description: The number printed on it ("FC-415483"). Labelled "Number" in the UI. Unique per carrier (TO CONFIRM).

pin.description: PIN / access code. Treat as a secret: returned only to full-access roles (TO CONFIRM).

expiryDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD; null = never runs out. Must be ≥ issueDate.

status.description: Derived from expiryDate on every write and nightly: < 0 days Expired, ≤ 30 days Expiring Soon, else Active (TO CONFIRM — the prototype lets the user pick it).

basis.description: Which date the alert counts back from.

assigneeUserId.description: → `users._id`; who acts on the alert (not settable in the UI yet).

assignedAssetId.description: The UNIT it is on → `assets._id`. Only when handling includes asset-removable.

assignedAssetKind.description: Copied from the asset on assignment.

assignedDriverId.description: The PERSON answerable for it → `drivers._id`. Only when handling includes driver-returnable.

assignedAt.description: When the current assignment was made.

contactName.description: Vendor contact copied at creation (kept for the item page).

contactInfo.description: Vendor email / phone copied at creation.

deletedAt.description: Soft delete (no delete exists today — TO CONFIRM).

createdAt.description: Set by the server on insert.

updatedAt.description: Set by the server on every write.
